types.name: Screen / Aux
types.note: One bank for Screens and Aux Screens (User Manual §15). Recall to one destination affects only that destination.

types.name: Master
types.note: Loads the Screen memories it was saved with on the screens it includes. Which screens those are is not readable over AWJ/REST.

types.name: Multiviewer
types.note: Loads straight to the Multiviewer output; there is no Preview/Program and no last-loaded readback.

types.name: Layer
types.note: Layer memories (User Manual §15.4) have no AWJ or REST command, so they cannot be imported or recalled.
